Q: Check if Domain is registered or not without Whois? A:

You can use the free Domain WHOIS API on RapidAPI. It uses RDAP protocol and returns registrar, creation date, expiration date, nameservers in clean JSON.

Free tier: 5000 requests/month, no API key needed. Supports .com, .net, .org, .io and more.

https://rapidapi.com/buigialy30206/api/domain-whois-api1/playground/apiendpoint_72a4be4a-8f73-4b30-a5e8-75ef1f165b40
